# Price the visit, then price the route.

> Free calculator for independent dog walkers and pet sitters: price a walk, drop-in, or overnight from time, drive, mileage, extra pets, and overhead, then see your monthly route revenue and the gap to your income goal.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
